item.title: Two prisoners from Gaza released
item.description: Israeli occupation forces released two Palestinian prisoners from the Gaza Strip on Sunday evening. The prisoners, who had been detained since October 7, 2023, were transferred to Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah for medical treatment.
